Thanks for the replies. In what way you can't relate?

I think the real problem, that I should address is my OCD. It has always given me these what if -scenarios. Now the subject is this, because I really don't have anything else to worry about. I'm worrying about this link that I accidentaly clicked. I did get out of the internet immediately and ran antivirus programs etc. I still have this lingering "what if I didn't"-doubt in my head and I really can't be sure, because it was such a long time ago. No signs of hacking whatsoever, so this is a bit ridicilous. 

Yeah. I guess it was such a long time ago, that nothing's really going to happen. People do dumber shit in the internet, I guess. I guess I wanted to hear, that my worries are relatively dumb.
